Same-patch practice/custom test with exact state: record Ixtal Impact wall slam tooltip, observed AP/AD/HP/mana/resists, per-packet damage/protection and final targetHP. Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Verify raw helper/statFormula mappings and conditional multipliers before treating result as established.

Rune reasoning: Skarner — Ixtal Impact wall slam: E5 wall slam150+1.2 bonusAD+0.06 totalHP physical. AD package tests large ratio; Edge HP contributes small term; armor penetration applies. Bloodline replaces non-scoring haste: 85 HP directly feeds the slam's 6% own-total-HP term. Keep conditional native modifiers separate from rune proc damage. Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Manaflow Band: Earned maximum mana/resource utility; only actual mana conversions can turn it into offensive stats. Absolute Focus: Adaptive stats only while owner stays above 70% HP (starts at 100%). Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Legend: Bloodline: Exactly 15 earned stacks grant 85 HP, directly feeding this slam's 6% own-total-HP coefficient; life-steal recovery is separate. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

Rune preparation: Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time. Manaflow: log ten actually earned procs if using its 250 bonus mana; never invent full stacks or mana-to-AP conversion. Bloodline benchmark: exactly 15 legitimately earned Legend stacks before measurement, granting 85 max HP. Read actual HP/AP after equipped conversions; with fewer stacks credit no completion HP. No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.

Rune comparison: Compare a real prepared Conqueror page versus the selected page without changing target defenses, HP, earned item stacks, rank or time. Additional rune preparation must be its own recorded trial. Compare First Strike or a damage keystone only in a separately reported total-hit result; proc damage is outside the named native packet. Shard comparison: swap only flex scaling health versus adaptive force and read the actual final HP/AD/AP and native output. This is not a claim that health benefits other abilities lacking the coefficient.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the real AD/AP coefficient. Flex and defense scaling health each grant 180 HP at level 18; this helper has direct HP scaling or an explicit HP-to-offense conversion. Compare an adaptive flex shard at fixed final client stats; do not recursively amplify conversions.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The form loads the recorded target slot and any explicit benchmark overrides; other fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR). Adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Finite HP alternative may win elsewhere; no Heartsteel stacks assumed; carry not duplicate slam. Raw statFormula=2/Stat identifiers remain source evidence until runtime mapping confirmed; no unspecified stats/stacks granted.
tradeoffs: Six final items explicitly replace late-game boots; slower access/escape, extreme cost and setup dependence. Raw-number candidate sacrifices practical positioning and does not prove a global maximum.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.

These are reasoned choices and comparison candidates; not a complete numerical rune solver or in-game verification.

kitEvidence.formula:
Skarner charges forward, steering toward the chosen direction and ignoring terrain. If he runs into a champion or large monster, Skarner drags them along for the rest of his charge.

Colliding into a wall with an enemy in tow deals [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (1.2) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.06) × Stat(12)] physical damage to the enemy and Stuns them for [1.1]s.

Skarner can Recast this Ability to end his charge early.

kitEvidence.formula:
Skarner rips a boulder from the ground, empowering his next 3 Attacks with [(0.2 / 0.25 / 0.3 / 0.35 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Speed and dealing [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (0.9) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.03) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]] physical damage to surrounding enemies. His final Attack will deal an additional [11]% max Health physical damage and Slow affected foes by [40]% for [1]s.

Recast: Skarner ends this Ability and throws his boulder, dealing @spell.SkarnerQ:AbilityDamage@ + @spell.SkarnerQ:MaxHPPercent*100@% max Health physical damage, and additionally Slowing the first enemy hit — and any other surrounding enemies — by @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowPercent*100@% for @spell.SkarnerQ:SlowDuration@s.
